description:
Create a new clueprint (reusable video template). A clueprint is a structured file directory with design notes, composition rules, and screenshots that can be used to generate videos.

Use human-readable folder categories: design/ (colors, typography, backgrounds, animation), rules/ (composition, voiceover, editing), screenshots/ (rendered clip previews). See the "Creating Clueprints" section in the system instructions for the full structure.

If source_guide_ids are provided, guide data is extracted clip-by-clip into the clueprint (animations and images described, auto-element rules learned; can take minutes). Each non-empty decision list in the reply (animations_pending_mode, logo_animations, images_pending_mode, clips_pending_voiceover_policy, multi_split_summary, slide_count_strategy, the *_by_role groups, discovered_element_types_by_clip_type) is a choice to ask the user, then record with update_clueprint(decisions).
